title: DOOH Location
description: The disclosed geographic location of an installed DOOH or OOH placement: coordinates and address. All fields are optional, and changes to the location never change the placement's identity.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Uses `lon`, matching OpenRTB 2.6 and OpenOOH geo field naming used by DOOH data partners and measurement currencies, rather than this spec's general targeting.json `lng` convention.
